description: This file defines a YAML schema for the 'tlvProfile2SteeringRequest' structure used in a wireless networking context, specifically implementing a v2 specification for steering requests. It includes type definitions for TLV (Type-Length-Value) fields, nested structs and enums, and comments explaining the purpose of various fields.

classes.name: tlvProfile2SteeringRequest
classes.description: Class representing the Steering Request TLV with various fields including type, length, BSSID list, and target BSSID list.

classes.name: sRequestFlags
classes.description: Struct defining request flags including request mode and various bit flags.

classes.name: eRequestMode
classes.description: Enumeration for request modes: steering opportunity or mandate.

classes.name: sTargetBssidInfo
classes.description: Struct for target BSSID information including BSSID, operating class, channel number, and reason code.
